seed: The third guide of the Icons track: an icon is really made by changing a shape after it is drawn, because nobody clicks the right five points first time. The guide brings the 24 point frame with a bookmark on it, five hard corners, and teaches the two gestures nobody guesses: a double click on a POINT bends it, and a double click on a LEVER straightens that side. The walk drives the first three for real. The lever one it skips, because a lever only exists after the bend and its length is not a number a walk can know; that step is still held to finding its control on screen.

steps.note: the sample: a bookmark drawn on the 24 point frame, every corner on a crossing of the four point grid
THE TEST: picking the shape with the pointer put its points on it, with no second tool and no mode
the notch at the foot of the bookmark pulled up: the point moved and the runs either side of it came with it
THE OTHER TEST: a double click on the top right corner turned it into a smooth bend, and two levers appeared to steer it
the walk skipped the lever step rather than guessing where a lever ended up; the last card explains what each dot shape means
